text: DSH Computer Use（DSH 插件，DSH 工具层）：为 agent 提供以文本为主的 Chromium 浏览器和 macOS 桌面控制。它通过 `computer_observe` 生成带稳定元素引用的无障碍/OCR 快照，并由 `computer_action` 执行单个操作后返回新观察；支持网页导航、表单、标签页、文件上传，以及桌面应用的点击、键盘和滚动操作。适合需要让 DSH 在不依赖模型直接看屏幕的情况下操作网页或 macOS 应用的场景。需要 macOS 14+、DSH、Google Chrome，并为桌面控制授权辅助功能与屏幕录制；不需要 API key。

DSH Computer Use adds browser and macOS control to DSH. computer_observe returns accessibility/OCR text with refs; computer_action performs one action and reports updated state. Supports navigation, forms, tabs, uploads and desktop input. Requires macOS 14+, DSH, Chrome and desktop permissions.

DSH Computer Use 的功能「观察浏览器」：computer_observe 返回带稳定引用的 Chromium 文本快照，可选择交互控件、全文或变化，并按关键词筛选、设置 OCR。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「网页自动化」：通过 `computer_action` 操作 Chromium 页面，支持导航、标签页、点击、输入、选择、滚动、拖动和文件上传；每次只执行一个动作，并返回后续观察。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「macOS 桌面操作」：在 `desktop` 表面观察并控制原生应用，可启动或聚焦应用，再点击、键入、滚动、拖动和按键；观察使用无障碍信息并可补充 OCR。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「按变化和关键词筛选观察」：观察时选择交互控件、完整内容或与上次不同的元素，也可用 query 按角色、名称、值或状态过滤，输出受到字符上限约束。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「基于最新快照定位目标」：ref 或坐标类交互需要最近一次观察的 snapshot_id；过期快照或失效引用会报错并要求重新观察，减少对旧目标的误操作。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「浏览器文件上传」：`computer_action` 的 upload_files 动作接收输入框引用和文件路径；路径按 agent 会话工作区解析，动作由浏览器驱动执行。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「桌面 OCR 补充」：macOS 桌面观察可自动、强制或关闭 OCR，并可配置 Vision 语言列表；OCR 节点和辅助功能节点合并为语义观察结果。
DSH Computer Use 的功能「会话隔离与清理」：浏览器驱动按 agent 会话维护隔离上下文与标签页，并在 agent 释放时保存浏览器存储状态、清理会话快照和关闭驱动资源。
DSH Computer Use 使用前须知：桌面输入需要辅助功能权限，OCR 和截图需要屏幕录制权限；观察结果有节点上限，可能需要缩小范围后重试。

dsh-computer-use README · DMG：1. Download the latest `DSH-Computer-Use-*-universal.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest).
2. Drag **DSH Computer Use** into **Applications** and open it.

With either method, authorize **Accessibility** and **Screen Recording**, select **Install** under **DSH Plugin**, then restart the running DSH Host.

dsh-computer-use README · DMG：The Homebrew Cask and official DMG install the same Universal 2, Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized app. Users do not need Xcode, Swift, or this source checkout. DSH and Google Chrome must already be installed.

dsh-computer-use README · What it does：| Surface | Perception | Input |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chromium | Playwright, CDP accessibility/DOM, frames, tabs, optional OCR | Ref-pinned navigation, pointer, keyboard, forms, scroll, drag, upload |
| macOS | Accessibility tree first, Vision OCR for semantic gaps, independent window capture | AX actions, targeted SkyLight/CoreGraphics, global HID only without a target |

dsh-computer-use README · What it does：Every action returns a fresh bounded text observation. The model works with roles, names, values, state, geometry, and stable snapshot refs instead of assuming it can inspect screenshots. UI and OCR strings are explicitly untrusted data.

dsh-computer-use README · Background macOS control：- Carries PID, WindowServer window ID, AX window frame, and element identity through every action.
- Prefers semantic AX actions before coordinate input.
- Routes supported pointer and keyboard events directly to the target process/window.
- Uses a click-through software cursor; targeted actions do not move the physical pointer.
- Keeps post-action observation pinned to the previous target, even while another app stays active.
- Falls back to public CoreGraphics or fails closed when a private capability is unavailable.

dsh-computer-use README · Platform boundary：ScreenCaptureKit is public API. The optional background input path dynamically loads private SkyLight symbols and is intended for Developer ID distribution, not the Mac App Store. Private APIs are unsupported by Apple and can change between macOS releases.

dsh-computer-use README · Platform boundary：On macOS 26, Stage Manager may expose a shelved window only as a small WindowServer thumbnail. Constructing a capture filter for that representation can abort inside SkyLight. DSH Computer Use detects the geometry mismatch first, preserves AX observation, returns an explicit warning, and never stretches a thumbnail into a fake full-window screenshot.

dsh-computer-use README · DSH integration：The embedded package declares a DSH bundle in `package.json`. The setup center runs the official equivalent of:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add --save-exact file:/path/to/DSH\ Computer\ Use.app/Contents/Resources/Plugin
```

dsh-computer-use README · DSH integration：`cordis.patch.yml` installs the Host runtime and registers `computer_observe` / `computer_action` in DSH's global tool layer, inherited by every agent preset. No manual edits to user profile YAML or preset copies are required. The setup center detects an older dependency-only installation and repairs the missing bundle registration. A running DSH Host must be restarted after install, repair, or upgrade.

dsh-computer-use README · Build from source：Requirements: macOS 14+, Xcode/Swift 5.9+, Node.js 22+, pnpm 11+, DSH, and Google Chrome.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test
pnpm run test:native

`pnpm run build` creates:

```text
native/macos-helper/dist/DSH Computer Use.app
```

The default build is Universal 2. For faster local iteration:

```bash
COMPUTER_USE_ARCHS=arm64 pnpm run build
```

Create a local drag-to-Applications DMG:

```bash
pnpm run package:dmg
```

dsh-computer-use README · Build from source：Public releases require a `Developer ID Application` identity and notarization. See [documentation/distribution.md](documentation/distribution.md) for the exact local and GitHub Actions flows.

dsh-computer-use README · OCR languages and bounded desktop observations：OCR detects languages automatically by default. Set `ocrLanguages` on the `computer-use-host` configuration to an ordered list of Vision language identifiers, for example `["zh-Hans", "en-US"]`, to prefer Simplified Chinese and English. The same setting applies to desktop capture, display fallback, and browser OCR. Unsupported language identifiers produce an explicit OCR warning/error rather than silently dropping text; supported languages depend on the installed macOS version.
section: OCR languages and bounded desktop observations

text:
dsh-computer-use README · OCR languages and bounded desktop observations：Desktop AX traversal supports up to 64 levels and at most 2,000 nodes (`maxNodes` still defaults to 250 in the host). Depth/node cutoffs set `truncated` and include a warning. A bounded observation may still omit controls; narrow the view or observe again instead of guessing refs.

Development dependencies target DSH `0.2.1-alpha.1`; the earlier `0.1.0-rc.6` peer ranges remain accepted. This does not imply that every intervening DSH version or macOS runtime has been tested.
section: OCR languages and bounded desktop observations

text:
dsh-computer-use README · Tool contract：`computer_observe` returns `interactive`, `full`, or `changes` snapshots for `browser` and `desktop`, with optional query filtering and `auto | always | never` OCR.

`computer_action` performs exactly one browser or desktop action and returns the post-action semantic state. Ref and coordinate actions require the latest `snapshot_id`; stale targets fail closed and require another observation. File uploads are fenced to the DSH session workspace.
